state.paragraph: On May 31, 2013, Mac-Gray entered into an engagement letter with BofA Merrill Lynch with respect to the Board's undertaking a review of strategic alternatives, including a potential sale process, and in which BofA Merrill Lynch agreed not to engage as a possible source of new acquisition financing for any potential buyers in connection with any such sale process without Mac-Gray's prior written consent.
state.target_sentence: On May 31, 2013, Mac-Gray entered into an engagement letter with BofA Merrill Lynch with respect to the Board's undertaking a review of strategic alternatives, including a potential sale process, and in which BofA Merrill Lynch agreed not to engage as a possible source of new acquisition financing for any potential buyers in connection with any such sale process without Mac-Gray's prior written consent.

criteria.row_6: 05/30/2013 | BofA Merrill Lynch | Adviser | Re-engaged as the target's sole financial adviser for the strategic review and possible sale, chosen from three banks. Engagement letter 05/31; no buyer financing without consent.
criteria.row_7: 05/30/2013 | Moab Partners, L.P. | Activist | Moab (about 9% holder) won a proxy contest; Rothenberg and Hyman replaced incumbents. The filing does not say Moab pressed for a sale. Rothenberg was later excluded over Moab's rollover interest.
criteria.row_8: 06/21/2013 | Party A | Bid | price 17-19 | Unsolicited proposal to the board, made before any NDA or diligence (Heavy by context). It was still standing when round 1 was evaluated on 07/25.
criteria.row_9: 06/24/2013 | Mac-Gray (Special Committee) | Target sale decision | Board forms a Special Committee of six independent directors, excluding CEO MacDonald and Moab's Rothenberg. The committee will weigh a sale against staying stand-alone and approach 50 parties.
criteria.none: None of the ledger rows records the event reported in the target sentence, either as the row's own event or in its note.
criteria.not_an_event: The target sentence reports no discrete event of these kinds (background, reasoning, description or discussion only).

match.instructions: `target_sentence` (from a merger filing; `paragraph` gives context) appears to report that a financial or legal adviser is retained, engaged, terminated or first shown acting for the target, a committee or a bidder. Each option describes one row of a research ledger as date | party | event | note. Select the row that records the event reported in `target_sentence`: same party or group, same action, consistent date and terms, allowing paraphrase and allowing the event to be summarised in a row's note. A related event with a different party, date or action does not count.
